advisory_en: SHAKARPUR: flood probability 60% — risk level WATCH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 09:30 IST. About 51,957 residents are in the exposed area, with 10 hospital(s), 5 school(s) and 40.6 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, dense built-up. No pumping assets are mapped in this ward.
